text:
david: Launching a config-only canary now for model-x. Changes: routing policy -> cost-aware, batching window 25ms -> 40ms, request timeout 6000ms -> 5000ms. Canary traffic = 100 req/s on prod-us-east for 30m. Deploy bot should post status. Tag: config/2026-03-20/routing-batching-timeouts

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled and starting checks. Target=prod-us-east, model-x:v2 (config-only). Health probes warming, will report every 5m. :rocket:

alice: Can we pin enterprise tenants (acme, zenly) to model-x:v1 during the canary? They saw higher tail latency last time. If pinning is hard, add immediate fallback to v1 when p95 > 300ms for those tenants.

ben: We can add tenant-route exceptions. I'll create a route overlay: acme/zenly -> model-x:v1 for the canary window. Proposed rollback triggers: error rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 increase > +120ms sustained for 3m. Thoughts?

carla: Ops note: preferred change window is 23:00-01:00 PT. Are we able to wait? Otherwise need explicit approval for an early window.

david: We need this canary to finish before midnight for follow-on rollouts. Ops — can you approve a short window 21:30-22:15? @carla

carla: Ok, I can open a special 45m window 21:25-22:10. I'll set escalation to pager if rollback triggers. Make sure runbook is attached.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary start scheduled at 2178611100 (21:30 PT). Posting config diff:
```
- routing.policy: latency-prefer
+ routing.policy: cost-aware
- batching.window_ms: 25
+ batching.window_ms: 40
- request.timeout_ms: 6000
+ request.timeout_ms: 5000
```

ben: Also enabling prefix-cache for top-50 prompts to offset any extra token latency from batching. Adding synthetic probe hitting model-x every 10s and a tail-latency alert on p95.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: Release notes uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-20-config-routing-batching. Short summary: config-only routing -> cost-aware, batching window increase, tightened timeout.

david: Good. Rollback plan summary: revert routing policy and batching/window/timeouts to previous values and cut canary if trigger conditions hit. Keep traces and sample requests for debugging. If anyone sees early signs, call it and I'll ack rollback. :thumbsup:
